s.note: Golden shortcrust pies filled with potato, leek, cheddar and thyme
s.how: Boil the diced potato until just tender and drain well. Soften the leek in the butter. Mix the potato, leek, cheddar, thyme, salt and pepper and leave to cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 8 rounds of 12cm from the pastry, spoon in the filling, fold into half moons, crimp the edges and brush with egg. Bake on a lined tray until deep golden.

s.n: Jake and Bobbie Joe's hush puppies
s.note: Crisp fried cornmeal fritters with spring onion, served with honey butter
s.how: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Whisk the egg and buttermilk, stir into the dry mix with the spring onion and rest. Beat the butter with the honey. Heat the oil in a deep pot to 180C. Drop in heaped tablespoons of batter in batches and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with the honey butter.

m.note: Seared pork chops with apples, onion and sage in a creamy mustard pan sauce, with crushed potatoes
m.how: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush lightly with a fork and half the butter. Season the chops with the salt and pepper and sear in the oil for 4 minutes a side until just cooked. Rest on a plate. Fry the apples, onion and sage in the rest of the butter until golden. Add 250ml chicken stock and the mustard, bubble to reduce by half, then stir in the cream. Return the chops and their juices to warm through and serve with the potatoes.

w.note: Shortcrust filled with toasted pecans in a brown sugar and maple custard, with whipped cream
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm pie tin with the pastry and chill. Line with baking paper and rice and blind bake, then lift out the paper and rice. Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, maple syrup, butter, vanilla and salt. Scatter the pecans in the pastry case and pour over the filling. Bake until set with a slight wobble in the centre. Cool completely. Whip the cream to soft peaks and serve with slices of pie.

d.note: Black tea with fresh peach syrup and lemon over ice, with peach slices and mint
d.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes and remove. Simmer half the peach slices with the sugar and 100ml of the cold water until soft, then strain to a syrup. Stir the syrup, lemon juice and the rest of the cold water into the tea and chill. Pour over ice with the remaining peach slices and a sprig of mint.
